subject: CYCLE-1 TEST-RESULT: structural BackupReceipt schema passes but cross-field proof is insufficient
body: Cycle 1 completed 10/10 deterministic tests after correcting a local test-fixture path typo. The schema correctly rejects the existing NOT_EXECUTED candidate as a real receipt, missing remote commit, unverified remote bytes, post-hash snapshot mutation, lineage conflict, and empty part sets. Falsification also succeeded: a pure JSON Schema can still accept a part whose expected/observed SHA-256 differ, whose expected/observed byte counts differ, or whose verified_utc predates snapshot creation, because those cross-field/chronology relations are not expressible by the structural schema alone. Therefore schema-only validation is insufficient for a normative success receipt. Cycle 2 will add a required semantic validator contract and adversarial tests for digest equality, size equality, chronology, unique part paths, and deterministic idempotency key recomputation. Service publication was late during implementation/test execution; this record restores durable continuity.

service.blocker: JSON Schema alone cannot prove expected==observed, chronology, or deterministic idempotency
